name: Application Issues Decision Tree Knowledge Graph

nodes.name: Prompt Result (APPLICATION Domain): Affected User, Domain: Application, Mirror User, Login URL
nodes.description: Initial entry point for APPLICATION domain decision tree: Ingests Prompt Result containing Affected User, Domain: Application, Mirror User, and Login URL

nodes.name: Follow Login flowchart to find IsActive
nodes.description: Inspect user record in Salesforce to verify account active status (User.IsActive)

nodes.name: Is Active ?
nodes.description: Evaluate if the affected user account is active in Salesforce

nodes.name: Login Issue
nodes.decision_basis: User account is deactivated (IsActive=False). Issue is governed by the Login domain deactivation workflow.

nodes.name: Retrieve Assigned Permission sets and details
nodes.description: Retrieve all assigned Permission Sets, package licenses, and user permissions from Salesforce

nodes.name: Classify the IssueType
nodes.description: Classify target application based on ticket description (CC360, Pharma/Community, Conga/CLM/Apttus)

nodes.name: CC360 Issue?
nodes.description: Check whether the incident concerns Customer 360 (CC360 / Cloud Customer 360)

nodes.name: Pharm App Issue?
nodes.description: Check whether the incident concerns Pharma System or Community application

nodes.name: Conga App Issue?
nodes.description: Check whether the incident concerns Conga / CLM / Apttus application suite

nodes.name: Is CC360 Permission Set Assigned?
nodes.description: Verify if CC360 Permission Set (e.g. Cloud Customer 360 / CC360_User) is assigned to the user

nodes.name: Confirmed: CC360 Permission Set Missing
nodes.decision_basis: User is active, issue is classified as CC360, but user lacks CC360 Permission Set in Salesforce.
nodes.expected_criteria: CC360 Permission Set assigned to user

nodes.name: Is Only PS Community User Permission Set Assigned?
nodes.swimlane: Only PS Community Permission Set Missing
nodes.description: Verify if 'Only PS Community User' (or Pharma Community User) permission set is assigned to user

nodes.name: Confirmed: Only PS Community User Permission Set Missing
nodes.swimlane: Only PS Community Permission Set Missing
nodes.decision_basis: User is active and attempting to access Pharma/Community app, but 'Only PS Community User' permission set is missing from user record.
nodes.expected_criteria: Only PS Community User Permission Set assigned

nodes.name: Classify the IssueType / Analyse the Incident Description
nodes.description: Analyze incident narrative for specific Conga sub-symptoms (CLM Onboarding, CRM Content, X-Author, BU, Apttus access)

nodes.name: Has Description contains "CLM New User Onboarding Issue" Symptom?
nodes.description: Check if incident narrative contains CLM new user onboarding or setup symptoms

nodes.name: Is CLM Package Assigned?
nodes.description: Inspect UserPackageLicense to verify if Conga CLM / Apttus package license is assigned

nodes.name: Confirmed: CLM Package License Missing
nodes.decision_basis: User experiencing CLM New User Onboarding issue, and Conga CLM Package License (UserPackageLicense) is missing in Salesforce.

nodes.name: Has Description contained "CRM Content / Content Library Issue" Symptom?
nodes.description: Check if ticket description mentions CRM Content / Content Library access errors

nodes.name: Is UserPermissionsContentUser Enabled?
nodes.description: Check whether User.UserPermissionsSFContentUser is True in Salesforce

nodes.name: Confirmed: CRM Content User Not Enabled
nodes.decision_basis: User requires CRM Content / Content Library access, but UserPermissionsSFContentUser is False on their Salesforce user record.

nodes.name: Has Description contained "X-Author related issue" Symptom?
nodes.description: Check if description mentions Conga X-Author, X-Author for Excel, or contract template add-in

nodes.name: Is Agreement - Apttus X-Author Permission Set Assigned?
nodes.description: Verify whether Apttus / Conga X-Author Permission Set is assigned to the user

nodes.name: Confirmed: X-Author Permission Missing
nodes.decision_basis: User experiencing X-Author issue, and Apttus X-Author Permission Set is missing from user record in Salesforce.
nodes.expected_criteria: Agreement - Apttus X-Author Permission Set assigned

nodes.name: Determine BU and Access Level from Description
nodes.description: Determine whether Business Unit (BU) and Access Level are present and valid in user profile or ticket narrative

nodes.name: Confirmed: BU Missing
nodes.decision_basis: User's Business Unit (BU) or Access Level cannot be determined or is missing in Salesforce configuration.
nodes.expected_criteria: Valid Business Unit and Access Level configured

nodes.name: Has Description contained "Permission or Access issue" Symptom?
nodes.description: Check if description mentions general Apttus/Conga agreement permission or access errors

nodes.name: Is Agreement - Apttus Permission Set Assigned?
nodes.description: Verify whether Agreement - Apttus / Conga Permission Set is assigned to user

nodes.name: Confirmed: Apttus Permission Missing
nodes.decision_basis: User experiencing Apttus agreement permission or access issue, and Agreement Apttus Permission Set is missing from Salesforce.

nodes.name: L3 Group Resolver
nodes.decision_basis: All checked permissions and package licenses are already assigned in Salesforce. Escalated to L3 Group Resolver for specialized analysis.

nodes.name: L3 Queue Resolver
nodes.decision_basis: Reported application issue is not CC360, Pharma, or recognized Conga symptoms. Ticket routed to L3 Queue Resolver.
